qa_pair.question: Verify the native backend, inspect synthetic_raw.fif, then read its sampling metadata. What is the theoretical Nyquist frequency in Hz? Return an integer.
After verifying status and the sampling metadata of synthetic_raw.fif, compute the sample interval in milliseconds. Return an integer.
Inspect both synthetic FIFF fixtures using native tools. What is the ratio of their sampling frequencies? Return an integer.
Verify the backend and inspect synthetic-ave.fif. How many evoked datasets are verified? Return the structured dataset count as an integer.
Read sampling metadata and the native summary of synthetic-ave.fif. How many sample intervals span its reported time range? Return an integer.
Verify the native backend and summarize synthetic-ave.fif. What is the difference between the last and first reported time points in milliseconds? Return an integer.
Verify backend status and inspect the evoked fixture. What is its averaging count, without treating it as participant count? Return an integer.
Inspect the block structure and evoked summary of synthetic-ave.fif. How many channels does its native summary report? Return an integer.
Verify backend status and read synthetic_raw.fif metadata. Does successful readiness authorize this bridge to perform its blocked native filter workflow? Return True or False.
Read synthetic-ave.fif metadata and evoked summary after checking backend status. Can these outputs alone establish the number of independent participants? Return True or False.
